changes.title: Beluga whales transferred to U.S. aquariums after Canadian theme park closes
changes.summary: Nearly 30 beluga whales were sent to aquariums across the U.S. in a multinational emergency operation after their home aquarium in Canada shuttered. Jared Ochacher reports.

changes.title: As Canada Opens Gordie Howe International Bridge, Americans Are Told to Stay Home
changes.summary: After a delay ordered by President Trump and new tariffs against Canada, the bridge between Windsor, Ontario, and Detroit opens in “underwhelming” fashion on Friday.

changes.title: China Has Come Through Trump’s Trade War in a Good Position
changes.summary: Despite threats from President Trump, the overall average weighted tariff on Chinese goods remained about the same, and is now lower than countries like Brazil and Canada.
